name: Variable Set-up
description: A mechanic where the initial state of the game (board configuration, starting resources, player positions, available goals, etc.) changes from one play to the next. This can be achieved through random draws of tiles or cards, player choices during a pre-game phase, or scenario-specific instructions. It aims to increase replayability by ensuring each game starts differently.

parameters.name: Method of Variation
parameters.description: How is variability introduced during setup (e.g., random tile draw, card drafting, scenario book, player choices from options, modular board assembly).
parameters.default_value: Random tile draw for map layout

parameters.name: Scope of Variation
parameters.description: Which game elements are variable (e.g., map layout, starting resources, player powers, available goals, initial unit placement).

parameters.name: Degree of Randomness vs. Choice
parameters.description: Is the setup purely random, purely player-driven, or a mix (e.g., players draft from a random pool)?
parameters.default_value: Mix of random draw and player choice

parameters.name: Impact on Strategy
parameters.description: How significantly does the variable setup affect initial strategies and game arc?
parameters.default_value: Significant impact, requires adapting strategy each game

examples_in_games.specific_implementation_notes: Hexagonal board tiles (resources, numbers) are laid out randomly or semi-randomly each game, creating a different resource distribution.
Players start with different corporations (variable player powers) and initial hands of project cards, leading to varied starting strategies. Map milestones/awards can also vary.
Each scenario has a unique map layout, monster set, and objectives, defined by the scenario book.
The galaxy map is built by players choosing and placing system tiles, leading to a unique board configuration each game. Public objectives are also drawn randomly.
Map tiles are revealed as players explore, creating a variable board. Scenarios also dictate specific setup rules and goals.

notes_on_combination_modification: Variable set-up is a powerful tool for enhancing replay value and challenging players to adapt. The key is to ensure that variations remain balanced and interesting, rather than creating overly swingy or unfair starting positions. It can range from minor tweaks to entirely different game experiences each play.
